I. 5 U. (चिनोति, चिनुते, चिका-चा-य, चिच्ये-क्ये, अचैषीतचेष्ट, चेतुम्, -चित; caus. चाययति, चापयति, also चययति, चपयति desid. चिचीषति, -चिकीषति) 
__1 To collect, gather, accumulate (said to govern two accusatives being a द्विकर्मक root, but this use is very rare in classical literature), वृक्षं पुष्पाणि चिन्वती. 
__2 To gather for oneself, acquire, gain; चिचीषतां जन्मवतामलध्वीं भूतिम् [[Ki. 3. 11]]; 2. 19; [[Mv. 3. 4.]] 
__3 To search, look out for; [[Bh. 3. 46.]] 
__4 To pile or heap up, place in a line; पर्वतानिव ते भूमावचैषुर्वानरोत्तमान् [[Bk. 15. 76.]] 
__5 To set, inlay, cover or fill with, see चित. -pass. To bear fruit, grow, increase, [Page0706-1] thrive, prosper; सिच्यते चीयते चैव लता पुष्पफलप्रदा [[Pt. 1. 222]] bears fruit; चीयते बालिशस्यापि सत्क्षेत्रपतिता कृषिः [[Mu. 1. 3]]; गजहंस तव सैव शुभ्रता चीयते न च न चापचीयते [[K. P. 10.]] --II. 3 P. (चिकेति) Ved. 
__1 To observe, see, perceive. 
__2 To look steadfastly upon. 
__3 To be intent upon. 
__4 To seek for, search, investigate, make inquiries, search through. --III. 1 Ā. (चयते) 
__1 To detest, hate. 
__2 To revenge, take vengeance on. --IV. 1 U. (चायति-ते) 
__1 To fear, dread, be afraid of (with acc.) 
__2 To respect, honour. 3 To observe; cf. चाय्.
